Positioned in the fifth main chapter of the work, it functions as the detailed exposition (*niddesa*) of the section on designations (*paṇṇattivāra*), following and systematically developing the brief matrix set forth in the preceding *Paṇṇattivārauddesa* (Ya 5.1.1) [DharmaNexus].
